name: log_stock
population: territorial unit x year, stock at t-1 of the same publication series
unit: ln(1 + stock in the asset unit)
source: BDGD aggregate of the asset (checkpointed Parquet)
availability: revision availability of the t-1 publication
original_unit: asset unit (customers, items, kVA or km)

name: urban_share
population: municipality x year, UCBT customers with known TARE area
dependencies: UCBT.ARE_LOC | TARE domain DDA M10 v1.1 | min known coverage 0.99
availability: revision availability of the t-1 publication

name: log_energy_per_client
population: municipality x year, UCBT customers with complete 12-month energy
unit: ln(1 + kWh per client per year)
availability: revision availability of the t-1 publication

name: log_population
dependencies: IBGE Census 2022 / annual estimates | MUN code
availability: release date per vintage; downloads are not backdated

name: dec
population: conjunto x year (consumer set), ANEEL continuity
dependencies: ANEEL DEC by conjunto | CONJ link

name: fec
population: conjunto x year (consumer set), ANEEL continuity
dependencies: ANEEL FEC by conjunto | CONJ link

name: log_ucbt_clients
population: unit x year, active UCBT customers (UC-v3) at t-1
availability: availability of the UCBT publication at t-1

name: log_trafo_count
population: unit x year, TUC 565 transformers linked EQ->UN at t-1
availability: availability of the transformer publication at t-1

name: log_trafo_kva
population: unit x year, nominal kVA of TUC 565 transformers at t-1
availability: availability of the transformer publication at t-1

name: log_clients_per_trafo
population: unit x year, declared ratio customers / TUC 565 transformers at t-1
availability: later of the two publication availabilities

name: log_kva_per_client
population: unit x year, declared ratio nominal kVA / customers at t-1
availability: later of the two publication availabilities
